assessments.reasoning: Archive members HyperSpec/Body/11_aaba.htm and HyperSpec/Body/11_aabb.htm provide the package mapping, export and internal-inheritance rules in §§11.1.1.2.1–2.

challenge.method: I cross-checked the two exact package sections and separated export status, package-local presence and inherited accessibility from explicit qualified reader access.
challenge.results: Export makes an entry external in its exporting package. use-package can make documented mappings available by inheritance. Reader access to an internal symbol uses a different mechanism, and the package status is relative to each package.

limitations: The evidence concerns a valid package use relationship. Name conflicts, shadowing, explicit imports and qualified reader access keep their own conditions.
